    # Split at the uniform separator column. The shared foreground color
    # in the two panels is the color to keep.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = None
    for c in range(w):
        vals = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}
        if len(vals) == 1 and (vals.pop() in (0, 9)):
            sep = c
            break

        raise ValueError("separator column not found")
    left = [grid[r][:sep] for r in range(h)]
    right = [grid[r][sep+1:] for r in range(h)]
    lc = {v for row in left for v in row if v != 0}
    rc = {v for row in right for v in row}
    common = lc & rc

        # a key with several colors by selecting the color present in right.
        common = {v for v in lc if v in rc}

        raise ValueError("could not identify shared color")
    keep = next(iter(common))
    return [[keep for _ in row] for row in right]
